style: Say softly and calmly, like a mindfulness teacher
lines: This is a map of ways people handle stress. Click any pin to look around, or try a situation.
Here's what stress does in the body. Click a spot to read about it, and compare a short burst with stress that keeps going.
You can build your own map here. Pick what fits you. It stays on this computer, and you don't have to fill in anything.
Click a pin to read about it. Pick a situation to see which routes fit.
Flip between the part they can change and the part they can't. Watch the routes move.
Click a spot on the figure. Then switch between a short burst and stress that keeps going.
Click chips to add them. Save keeps it on this computer, Clear erases it, Print gives you a copy.
If you need to talk, a trusted adult at school can help. In the US, you can call or text nine eight eight, any time.
